request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Recolour the dark grey skin to a clear cornflower blue with navy blue shading, with no grey skin anywhere, and make the inside of the mouth dark navy blue instead of red. Widen the red scarf into a big plain bright red bib over the chest and shoulders, and add two plain bright red cloth bands round the tail. Change nothing else: keep the cream belly, jaw, teeth and claws, the pose, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
